# Claude

> > Claude by Anthropic: Enterprise AI platform featuring Claude Code for autonomous programming, Claude Marketplace for integrated AI tools, and solutions spanning life sciences, code modernization, and education.

Claude offers enterprise-grade AI products including Claude Code (an IDE-integrated coding agent), Claude Marketplace (curated AI partners like GitLab, Harvey, and Snowflake), and industry-specific solutions. The platform emphasizes security, compliance, and developer productivity with deployment options across AWS Bedrock, GCP, and Azure.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code
- Claude Marketplace
- Enterprise AI solutions
- Code modernization and legacy system migration
- IDE integration and autonomous programming
- Developer productivity tools
- Claude Builder Clubs and Campus Program
- Regional compliance and data residency
- Life sciences and biotech research
- Enterprise integrations (Slack, Jira, Confluence)
- SSO and security features
- GitLab, Harvey, Lovable partnerships
- AWS Bedrock, GCP, Azure deployments

## Enterprise Products

- [Claude Code for Enterprise](https://claude.com/de-de/product/claude-code/enterprise): Enterprise coding agent with IDE integration and codebase migration
- [Enterprise Plan Pricing](https://claude.com/fr-fr/pricing/enterprise): Enterprise plan with SSO, compliance, Jira/Confluence integrations
- [Claude Marketplace](https://claude.com/platform/marketplace): Curated AI-powered partners like GitLab & Harvey with unified billing
- [Claude Marketplace (Korean)](https://claude.com/ko-kr/platform/marketplace): Claude Marketplace for enterprise AI tools with unified spending

## Industry Solutions

- [Code Modernization](https://claude.com/solutions/code-modernization): Legacy system modernization with Claude Code AI automation
- [Life Sciences Solutions](https://claude.com/ja-jp/solutions/life-sciences): Biotech research acceleration with Broad Institute & Terra.bio integration

## Education & Community

- [Claude Campus Program](https://claude.com/ja-jp/programs/campus): Student-led AI initiative with Builder Clubs and campus ambassadors

## Compliance & Security

- [Regional Compliance](https://claude.com/ja-jp/regional-compliance): Regional compliance, data residency via AWS, GCP, Azure deployments
